text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Eishin Flash welcomed her second summer training camp—
with a remarkably refreshed look on her face."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn), our target race,
isn't far off.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Let's approach this summer camp as our final opportunity to build up your fundamental strength.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Once I've done what needs to be done—
I am also considering retirement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This might be the last summer training camp I get to spend with Eishin Flash...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I will sear the sight of her running into my memory.
Deep in my heart, I made that resolution.
